name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and hold a dumbbell straight above each shoulder, palms facing inward.
Set your shoulder blades back and point both upper arms steadily toward the ceiling.
Bend your elbows under control to lower both dumbbells beside your temples.
Extend both elbows to press the dumbbells back above your shoulders.
tips: Keep your upper arms parallel without letting your elbows flare apart.
Move smoothly with neutral wrists and keep your shoulders anchored to the bench.
